cooked:
Thanks Arthur, good list. We ran all three, and all three passed.

  1. Payment cut off halfway, a crash, then a retry. The person paid once, the shop was paid once, and the retry was refused. We also found a small bug in Fiber and reported it: nervosnetwork/fiber#1724.
  2. Connection lost until the channel is closed. Every payment ended correctly, and the payer ended with exactly the right balance.
  3. Leaving with the LSP switched off. With only the recovery file, the wallet got all its money back.
    We also did the same exit from the wallet’s own recovery page, on the public testnet: all the money came back within three hours. One small payment was still in progress when the LSP went down. It comes back when it expires, on 9 November, and we will post that result then.
